description: Test suite for category management functions in the focalboard server application, including creation, updating, deletion, reordering, and validation of categories.

methods.name: TestCreateCategory
methods.description: Tests the creation of categories, including validation of required fields and invalid types.

methods.name: TestUpdateCategory
methods.description: Tests updating categories, including permission checks, validation, and restrictions on system categories.

methods.name: TestDeleteCategory
methods.description: Tests deletion of categories, including handling of already deleted and system categories.

methods.name: TestMoveBoardsToDefaultCategory
methods.description: Tests moving user boards to a default category, handling cases where default exists or needs creation.

methods.name: TestReorderCategories
methods.description: Tests reordering categories, ensuring all categories are included and order is validated.

methods.name: TestVerifyNewCategoriesMatchExisting
methods.description: Validates that new category lists match existing categories in count and IDs.
